name: Hide Archived Apps Toggle
description: Adds an experimental setting to Smart Launcher 6 to filter out archived apps from the app drawer.

name: Shizuku App Archiving
description: Adds a context menu item to archive apps via Shizuku (`pm archive`) in Smart Launcher 6.

name: Official Device App Archiving
description: Enables system PackageInstaller/LauncherApps native archiving on supported devices (e.g. S22 Ultra with One UI / Android 15+).
